brief.text: Closed-End Funds dominate the cluster activity, with five distinct tickers including BPRE, PSUS, and CRAFX generating multiple concurrent purchases. BORR recorded the single largest cluster total at $57.14 million across three insiders, significantly surpassing the next largest dollar commitment of $32.81 million at BPRE. FUL stands out for insider headcount with eight separate buyers taking $1.12 million in shares, while RENT drew concentrated 10% owner activity with Story3 Capital, Nexus Capital, and Chs US Investments combining for over $6.1 million in notable purchases.
